claim.quote: In the most central Au+Au collisions at the highest beam energy, evidence is found for the formation of a very high energy density system whose description in terms of simple hadronic degrees of freedom is inappropriate.

name: PHOBOS perspective on discoveries at RHIC
notes: The collaboration says "evidence is found for", so the result type is evidence, not discovery.

summary.plain: PHOBOS's 2005 summary of what its data show: in the most central gold-gold collisions at the top RHIC energy there is evidence of a very high energy-density system that cannot be described by simple hadronic degrees of freedom, and whose constituents interact strongly.
summary.technical: Conclusions from the PHOBOS data to date: evidence for a very high energy-density system in central 200 GeV Au+Au collisions whose description in terms of simple hadronic degrees of freedom is inappropriate, with interacting constituents, and simple scaling behaviours of particle production at RHIC energies.

title: The PHOBOS Perspective on Discoveries at RHIC
why_it_matters: One of the four 2005 RHIC white papers assessing the nature of the matter created in heavy-ion collisions at RHIC.
